title: Sparkly toothbrush
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id='handle' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='0'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#33d6ff'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#1a9ee6'/>
    </linearGradient>
    <linearGradient id='grip' x1='0' y1='0' x2='1' y2='0'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ff5fa2'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#e0428a'/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>
  <!-- handle, diagonal from lower-left to upper-right -->
  <g transform='rotate(-35 50 50)'>
    <!-- handle body -->
    <rect x='44' y='30' width='12' height='58' rx='6' fill='url(#handle)'/>
    <!-- grip stripes -->
    <rect x='44' y='60' width='12' height='7' rx='3' fill='url(#grip)'/>
    <rect x='44' y='71' width='12' height='7' rx='3' fill='url(#grip)'/>
  </g>
  <!-- brush head, angled up-right -->
  <g transform='rotate(-35 50 50)'>
    <rect x='45' y='18' width='10' height='16' rx='5' fill='#7fe8ff'/>
    <!-- bristles -->
    <g fill='#ffffff'>
      <rect x='46' y='10' width='2' height='9' rx='1'/>
      <rect x='49' y='9' width='2' height='10' rx='1'/>
      <rect x='52' y='10' width='2' height='9' rx='1'/>
      <rect x='55' y='11' width='1.5' height='8' rx='1'/>
    </g>
  </g>
  <!-- sparkles -->
  <g fill='#ffe94a'>
    <path d='M22 22 l2 6 6 2 -6 2 -2 6 -2 -6 -6 -2 6 -2 z'/>
    <path d='M82 34 l1.5 4.5 4.5 1.5 -4.5 1.5 -1.5 4.5 -1.5 -4.5 -4.5 -1.5 4.5 -1.5 z'/>
    <path d='M74 78 l1.5 4.5 4.5 1.5 -4.5 1.5 -1.5 4.5 -1.5 -4.5 -4.5 -1.5 4.5 -1.5 z'/>
    <path d='M18 66 l1.2 3.6 3.6 1.2 -3.6 1.2 -1.2 3.6 -1.2 -3.6 -3.6 -1.2 3.6 -1.2 z'/>
    <path d='M60 14 l1 3 3 1 -3 1 -1 3 -1 -3 -3 -1 3 -1 z'/>
  </g>
  <!-- small white sparkle dots -->
  <g fill='#bff4ff'>
    <circle cx='30' cy='42' r='2'/>
    <circle cx='70' cy='60' r='1.8'/>
    <circle cx='88' cy='62' r='2.2'/>
    <circle cx='40' cy='88' r='1.8'/>
  </g>
</svg>
